residual_risks: This is an isolated visual exploration on feat/renewal; it has not been deployed to AWS production.

Vimeo and outbound institution destinations depend on external availability; video remains lazy-loaded and does not autoplay.
Preview inherits public template copy. Added explanatory marketing text belongs to this branch and can be revised during review.
